criteria.name: Fact investigation & the minor-client interview
criteria.description: Elicits the client's own account through developmentally appropriate, non-leading questioning; builds a chronology; identifies the conflicting accounts and evidentiary gaps (dim footage, missing phone video, incomplete text thread, single identifying administrator).

subcriteria.name: Eliciting the account without leading
subcriteria.description: Uses open-ended prompts and secures Jasmine's own version before the adults reshape it; reaches the rapport-gated facts (the video, the panic attacks, Andre's keying) through proper triggers, not pressure.

subcriteria.name: Chronology & proof-gap analysis
subcriteria.description: Assembles an accurate chronology and expressly flags every conflict and evidentiary gap in the file, including the ambiguous surveillance and the incomplete group-chat export.

criteria.name: Counseling the distressed juvenile and parent
criteria.description: Builds trust with a frightened minor and manages an overwhelmed, self-blaming parent, keeping the child's voice and priorities primary.

subcriteria.name: Rapport & developmentally appropriate communication
subcriteria.description: Communicates with Jasmine in a calm, non-judgmental, age-appropriate way that preserves her confidence and does not treat her as a troublemaker.

subcriteria.name: Managing the parent's role & expectations
subcriteria.description: Handles Ana's distress, guilt, and financial fear, corrects misunderstandings, and keeps decision-making centered on the client.

criteria.name: Disposition strategy: diversion vs. contested jurisdictional hearing
criteria.description: Analyzes the informal-diversion offer against a contested jurisdictional hearing and prepares a negotiation plan, including a restitution position grounded in Jasmine's disputed role and the eyewitness attribution of the keying to Andre.

subcriteria.name: Risk/benefit analysis of the diversion offer
subcriteria.description: Weighs the no-record benefit against the responsibility-acknowledgment requirement and the innocence claim; states best- and worst-case outcomes.

subcriteria.name: Negotiation plan on terms and restitution
subcriteria.description: Prepares a concrete negotiation plan on diversion terms and apportioned restitution, using the proof gaps and the co-participant attribution as leverage.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Identifies and correctly navigates the Rule 4.2 no-contact problem with the represented co-participant and the confidentiality dynamics of a minor client with a parent present and prior un-counseled school questioning.

subcriteria.name: Rule 4.2 — the represented co-participant
subcriteria.description: Spots that Kayla is represented and does not contact her directly; routes any inquiry through her public defender.

subcriteria.name: Confidentiality, privilege & the parent/child dynamic
subcriteria.description: Handles privilege and confidentiality with a parent present, addresses the un-counseled school questioning, and counsels honestly on the concealed conduct.
